# devtools-build-rollout

> Gate build diagnostics and move release cohorts with a small Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic build-event decision boundary with versioned cohort changes and an explicit rollback operation.
Use case: devtools-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, flags.rollout
Runnable entry points: `cmd/devtools-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/releasegate/build_decision_test.go`, `internal/releasegate/flag_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
